clarity.notes: Faithful to design doc: doc selection → check → threads → diff → apply. Every action is discoverable.

hierarchy.notes: Split-pane with clear thread card structure. Diff viewer isolates changes with per-hunk bars.

typography.notes: Inter 14px UI / 18px editor. Mono for metadata. TextMate fallback stack shipped.

motion.notes: Overlay transitions, toast, float-pop animation. Could add slide transitions for rail/diff.

brand.notes: TextMate palette strict: 6 tokens + teal secondary. Lucide icons. 6px radius. Read-only badge + mode toggle.
